# telnyx_porting_loa_configuration (Resource)

A letter of authorization (LOA) template used for porting orders.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (Attributes) The address of the company. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--address))
- `company_name` (String) The name of the company
- `contact` (Attributes) The contact information of the company. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contact))
- `logo` (Attributes) The logo to be used in the LOA. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--logo))
- `name` (String) The name of the LOA configuration

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the LOA configuration.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization that owns the LOA configuration
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.

<a id="nestedatt--address"></a>
### Nested Schema for `address`

Required:

- `city` (String) The locality of the company
- `country_code` (String) The country code of the company
- `state` (String) The administrative area of the company
- `street_address` (String) The street address of the company
- `zip_code` (String) The postal code of the company

Optional:

- `extended_address` (String) The extended address of the company


<a id="nestedatt--contact"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contact`

Required:

- `email` (String) The email address of the contact
- `phone_number` (String) The phone number of the contact


<a id="nestedatt--logo"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logo`

Required:

- `document_id` (String) Identifies the document that contains the logo.

Read-Only:

- `content_type` (String) The content type of the logo.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:
